name: evolution-log
description: Every bootstrap/evolution session as a learning event. Each row = one run = one lesson.

evolution_events.description: One row per evolution session (bootstrap, retry, repair, etc.)
columns: id          TEXT  PRIMARY KEY,  -- uuid
session_id  TEXT  NOT NULL,     -- e.g. boot-apostlej-001
source      TEXT  NOT NULL,     -- which bootstrap/forge invoked this
origin      TEXT  NOT NULL,     -- zo name / machine label
outcome     TEXT  NOT NULL,     -- EVOLVED | COMPLETE | FAILED | RETRY_PENDING
ran_at      TEXT  NOT NULL,     -- ISO timestamp when session started
finished_at TEXT,               -- ISO timestamp when session ended
duration_ms  INTEGER,           -- how long the session ran
mode         TEXT,               -- install | retry | repair | evolve
errors_encountered INTEGER DEFAULT 0,  -- count of errors
forges_created  INTEGER DEFAULT 0,      -- count of new forges generated
corrections_applied INTEGER DEFAULT 0, -- count of auto-corrections
can_retry   BOOLEAN DEFAULT true,      -- whether retry is possible
retry_after TEXT,                       -- ISO timestamp for retry window
notes        TEXT                        -- human-readable summary

evolution_errors.description: One row per error/warning encountered during evolution
columns: id            TEXT  PRIMARY KEY,  -- uuid
session_id    TEXT  NOT NULL,     -- FK to evolution_events
phase         TEXT  NOT NULL,     -- which phase (persona_sync, skill_install, etc.)
error_type    TEXT  NOT NULL,     -- MISSING | STALE | CONFLICT | UNKNOWN | PARSE
severity      TEXT  NOT NULL,     -- WARNING | ERROR | BLOCKING
detail        TEXT,               -- full error message
forge_generated TEXT,             -- script forge created from this error (if any)
forge_file    TEXT,               -- path where forge was written
registered    BOOLEAN DEFAULT false, -- whether forge was registered
talkback_sent BOOLEAN DEFAULT false, -- whether hive was notified
talkback_id   TEXT,               -- hive response ID if received
resolved     BOOLEAN DEFAULT false,  -- whether error was resolved in session
resolution   TEXT                  -- how it was resolved

forge_generations.description: One row per new forge generated during evolution
columns: id              TEXT  PRIMARY KEY,  -- uuid
session_id      TEXT  NOT NULL,     -- FK to evolution_events
error_id        TEXT,               -- FK to evolution_errors (what triggered this)
forge_id        TEXT  NOT NULL,     -- e.g. bootstrap/startup-map-v1
forge_name      TEXT  NOT NULL,     -- human name
forge_type      TEXT  NOT NULL,     -- patch | seed | wrapper | validator
trigger_prompt  TEXT,               -- the auto-generated prompt that created it
generated_at   TEXT  NOT NULL,      -- ISO timestamp
file_path       TEXT,               -- where the forge was written
registered      BOOLEAN DEFAULT false, -- in script-registry?
talkback_sent   BOOLEAN DEFAULT false, -- notified hive?
hive_verified  BOOLEAN DEFAULT false, -- hive confirmed receipt
reused_count   INTEGER DEFAULT 0     -- how many times this forge was reused

talkback_log.description: Outbound talkback events sent to Hive
columns: id            TEXT  PRIMARY KEY,  -- uuid
endpoint      TEXT  NOT NULL,     -- which hive endpoint
payload_type  TEXT  NOT NULL,     -- EVOLUTION | FORGE_REG | HEARTBEAT | ERROR_REPORT
payload       TEXT  NOT NULL,     -- JSON stringified body
sent_at       TEXT  NOT NULL,     -- ISO timestamp
response_id   TEXT,               -- hive's response id
response_code INTEGER,             -- HTTP status code
response_body TEXT,                -- hive's response
verified      BOOLEAN DEFAULT false, -- got acknowledgement
next_retry   TEXT                  -- ISO timestamp

system_snapshots.description: Periodic state snapshots of the local zo system
columns: session_id    TEXT,               -- if taken during a session
hive_synced   BOOLEAN
last_error    TEXT

indexes: CREATE INDEX idx_errors_unresolved ON evolution_errors(resolved) WHERE resolved = false
CREATE INDEX idx_talkback_pending ON talkback_log(verified) WHERE verified = false
